description: Returns a runnable example from a FrontMCP docs page: the files of one of its Playgrounds, with their tests, as the docs run them. Without `index`, lists the page's Playgrounds (numbered from 1, in page order) with their section and files.

index.description: Which Playground on the page, from 1.

path.description: The page, like /reference/sdk/tool or a frontmcp.dev URL.

version.description: A documented FrontMCP version, like "1.9.4", or a minor, like "1.9", for its newest patch. Pass the version resolve_version found for the project. Defaults to the version this endpoint serves.

name: get_example
title: Get a page's example
